description: She wears an opaque dark teal patterned gown with a low square neckline, structured fitted bodice and both sleeves ending at the elbows in broad gold woven borders. Gold trim edges the neckline, vertical bodice bands and layered floor-length skirt. Two round metal brooches sit at the upper bodice bands, and a broad dark teal belt carries metal medallions and a central ornamental plate. A separate beige woven wrap with dark teal and gold borders drapes loosely below the elbows along both forearms and hangs at her sides with fringe. The bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis remain covered by substantial opaque fabric; a pale underskirt and brown closed shoes show at the hem.
